issues.issue: Did the RAD err by refusing an oral hearing under s. 110(6) without giving any reasons?
issues.applicant_position: RAD gave no reasons for refusing an oral hearing under s. 110(6), so its decision is unreasonable.
issues.respondent_position: RAD considered the Report at length; a hearing was unnecessary because the decision to hold one is discretionary.
issues.result_quote: Accordingly, I find that the RAD committed a significant error in its omission of reasons for its refusal to hold an oral hearing.

issues.issue: Are the RAD's credibility findings and substantive reasonableness open to review?
issues.applicant_position: RAD's credibility analysis and conclusions are unreasonable, largely on the basis of the psychiatric Report.
issues.respondent_position: RAD considered the Report at length and concluded it did not overcome the RPD's credibility concerns.
issues.result_quote: I will not examine the Applicant’s arguments contesting the substantive reasonableness of the decision
